doc: Put generated interface into a running application: drafts checked against what it registers and how open it is, prepared, previewed as real pixels, committed as versions of a surface that undo takes back.

tools.name: generate.surfaces
tools.description: Where generated interface may go and how far: each surface the application declares (its name, what it is for, its version now), how open generation is (off, data, limited, all), the limits a draft is held to, and in limited the components and verbs it may use

tools.name: generate.draft
tools.description: A draft for a surface, taken through the stages it can reach at once: validated (a view document checked against the registered components, the limits and how open generation is — every problem at its JSON pointer) and prepared (built, nothing shown). Code (limited, all) is first evaluated, sandboxed, into its document

code.description: code that makes the document (limited, all), with language

tools.name: generate.preview
tools.description: A prepared draft shown without being kept: mounted at its surface unseen, the window's picture before and after (PNG) and the semantic changes it would bring, then the surface as it was

tools.name: generate.commit
tools.description: A prepared draft made the surface's next version: mounted, its version kept with who made it, and in the history so undo takes it back to the version before

tools.name: generate.restore
tools.description: A surface back to a version it had (0: empty), as a new step undo takes back

version.description: a version generate.versions lists; 0 for none

tools.name: generate.versions
tools.description: A surface's versions: each one's number, who made it, when, its draft and its document; and the one shown

tools.name: generate.drafts
tools.description: The drafts not yet committed or discarded: each one's surface, the stage it reached and its problems

tools.name: generate.a2ui
tools.description: A2UI messages (v0.8's surfaceUpdate, dataModelUpdate, beginRendering, deleteSurface; one, a list, or JSON lines of a stream): the components kept between calls, each surface that renders drafted as a view document — committed too when asked, so a stream shows as it comes; what is not read yet is named, not guessed
tools.undo: ui.undo for what it committed; generate.discard for its drafts

messages.description: A2UI messages: one, a list, or a string of JSON lines

surface.description: the surface every A2UI surface goes into (default: the one named as its surfaceId)

commit.description: commit each draft at once (a stream shown as it comes)

tools.name: generate.actions
tools.description: What the person did in generated interface, in order: each event a generated view emitted (an A2UI button's action: its name, surfaceId, sourceComponentId and context) with its number, the surface and the time — after `since`

since.description: the last number already read (0: from the first kept)

tools.name: generate.discard
tools.description: A draft let go: nothing shown changes
